questions.q: Which tool compiles Java source into bytecode?
questions.explain: javac is the compiler; java runs the result.

questions.q: What is the result of 10 % 3?
questions.explain: The remainder after dividing 10 by 3 is 1.

questions.q: Which comparison is correct for string content?
questions.explain: equals compares characters; == compares references.

questions.q: What does a break statement do inside a loop?
questions.explain: break leaves the innermost loop or switch.

questions.q: What is the value of new int[4][2].length?
questions.explain: The outer array holds 4 rows.

questions.q: Which keyword prevents a method from being overridden?
questions.explain: final methods cannot be overridden.

questions.q: Which constructor call must be the first statement in a subclass constructor?
options: Both super(...) and this(...) must be first
questions.explain: Both super(...) and this(...) must be the first statement when used.

questions.q: What does an interface default method provide?
questions.explain: Implementors inherit the default behaviour unless they override it.

questions.q: Which exception must be caught or declared?
questions.explain: IOException is a checked exception.

questions.q: What happens when finally contains a return?
questions.explain: A return in finally discards the previous return value.

questions.q: Which Map implementation sorts its keys?
questions.explain: TreeMap maintains sorted key order.

questions.q: What is the average complexity of HashSet.contains?
questions.explain: Hash-based lookup is constant time on average.

questions.q: What breaks the equals/hashCode contract?
questions.explain: Equal objects must have equal hash codes.

questions.q: Which wildcard allows adding elements to a list?
questions.explain: A super wildcard is a consumer, so writes are allowed.

questions.q: What does type erasure mean?
options: Generic type parameters are removed at runtime
questions.explain: The compiler erases type parameters to their bounds.

questions.q: Which class reads a file line by line efficiently?
questions.explain: BufferedReader buffers characters and provides readLine.

questions.q: Which is a terminal stream operation?
questions.explain: forEach consumes the stream; the others are intermediate.

questions.q: What does flatMap do?
options: Maps each element to a stream and flattens the result
questions.explain: flatMap performs a one-to-many transformation and flattens it.

questions.q: Which guarantees visibility across threads?
questions.explain: volatile establishes a happens-before edge for that variable.

questions.q: What is a race condition?
questions.explain: The result depends on interleaving of concurrent operations.

questions.q: How do you stop an ExecutorService gracefully?
questions.explain: shutdown stops new tasks; awaitTermination waits for completion.

questions.q: Which JDBC object prevents SQL injection?
questions.explain: PreparedStatement binds parameters rather than concatenating SQL.

questions.q: Which annotation makes a method an override checked by the compiler?
questions.explain: @Override verifies the signature matches a supertype method.

questions.q: Which design pattern ensures one instance?
questions.explain: Singleton controls construction so only one instance exists.

questions.q: What is the best first step when a Java service leaks memory?
questions.explain: Heap dumps identify what is still reachable and why.
